title: Nutty Chewy Middle Eastern Yellow Split Pea Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Middle Eastern stew featuring yellow split peas, with a nutty flavor and chewy texture, perfect for a cozy evening. This halal-friendly dish is air-fried for a crispy twist.
instructions: Rinse the yellow split peas and soak them in water for at least 4 hours or overnight. Drain and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the soaked and drained yellow split peas, 4 cups of water, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30-40 minutes or until the peas are tender.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew to your desired consistency, or leave it chunky if you prefer.

Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C). Transfer the stew to a heat-proof bowl and place it in the air fryer basket. Cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the top is crispy and golden brown.
Garnish with chopped pistachios and fresh parsley. Serve hot, with crusty bread or over rice.
